connects_to.relationship: AWS cloud hosting of BillionToOne's QCT test algorithms, bioinformatics platform and data center

contracts.signal: Prospectus supplier disclosure: BillionToOne maintains a data center within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and hosts the significant majority of its proprietary QCT algorithms, a crucial component of its test processing, on a cloud-based software platform pursuant to an agreement with AWS; its bioinformatics platform is hosted on third-party data center hosting facilities operated by AWS, and it also hosts its algorithms on AWS platforms directly. The algorithms run many of its tests and some R&D, and the company has no backup platform, server or other means to host them.

players.product: QCT single-molecule NGS (smNGS) prenatal (UNITY) and oncology (Northstar) cell-free DNA tests with proprietary algorithms

quarterly_data.signal: Prospectus: BillionToOne derives nearly all of its revenue from tests performed at its laboratory facility in Union City, California, with a small percentage from a second facility in Menlo Park, California, and expects to open a third laboratory facility in Austin, Texas in 2028. It relies on a limited number of suppliers, in some cases sole- or single-source suppliers, for certain sequencers, reagents, blood tubes and other laboratory equipment, instruments and materials (no supplier is named).
quarterly_data.figure: third laboratory facility (Austin, Texas) expected in 2028

quarterly_data.signal: Prospectus reimbursement position: as of December 31, 2024, BillionToOne's payor contracts encompassed approximately 225 million covered lives in the United States. The UNITY Carrier Screen holds PLA code 0449U with CMS pricing of $1,825 effective January 1, 2025; Northstar Select and Northstar Response hold PLA codes 0487U and 0486U with CMS pricing of $2,920 and $1,644. Medicare and Medicare Advantage coverage is secured for Northstar Select, and ASPs rose as 0449U and 0487U were added to payor coverage policies; the NORTH study and other ongoing studies are meant to support MolDX submissions for Northstar Response.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 225 million covered lives; CMS pricing $1,825 (0449U), $2,920 (0487U), $1,644 (0486U)

quarterly_data.signal: Prospectus pipeline and AI use: Response V2, a new version of Northstar Response, reaches a limit of detection of 0.01% tumor allele fraction, which the company says already matches the leading tumor-informed MRD assay; a tissue-free, pan-cancer MRD test was expected to be commercially available in 2026, and R&D funding for an early-detection test is included in the five-year strategic plan (the company estimates the US oncology diagnostic opportunity at over $100 billion a year, half of it early detection). Every function uses AI: overall cost per test fell 21% in the 24 months ended June 30, 2025, in part through automation and AI, and approximately 30% of internally developed code was generated by AI.
quarterly_data.figure: Response V2 limit of detection 0.01%; cost per test down 21% in 24 months to June 30, 2025; approximately 30% of code AI-generated

quarterly_data.signal: Prospectus financials: revenue for the six months ended June 30, 2025 was $125,536 thousand versus $69,086 thousand (82%), of which prenatal $116,928 thousand and oncology $7,124 thousand (versus $713 thousand). Gross margin was 65% in the three months ended June 30, 2025, up 14 percentage points; annualized revenue run-rate reached $266.3 million as of June 30, 2025, and run-rate per sales representative exceeded $1.8 million. Preliminary Q3 2025 estimates: total revenue $81,500 to $84,600 thousand versus $38,419 thousand, oncology revenue $8,000 to $9,000 thousand versus $1,138 thousand, income from operations of approximately $5.5 to $11.5 million versus a loss of $12.6 million, and total test volume of 162,900 versus 107,934.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 2025 revenue $125,536 thousand (+82%); Q3 2025 preliminary revenue $81,500 to $84,600 thousand; Q3 2025 test volume 162,900
